let cleaned : List Char :=
    s.data.filter (fun c => c.isAlpha || c.isDigit)
      |>.map Char.toLower

  let n := cleaned.length
  let startIndex := 0
  let endIndex := if n = 0 then 0 else n - 1

  let rec check (l r : Nat) : Bool :=
    if l >= r then
      true
    else if cleaned[l]? = cleaned[r]? then
      check (l - 1) (r - 1)
    else
      false

  check startIndex endIndex
